name: Hot Potato Battleground
review:
A chaotic army camp on a 7x7 cluster grid, with cell multipliers that upgrade where wins land and five feature symbols that each shake things up differently.

A busy area of the grid gets more valuable the more it wins, and the feature symbols keep the board unpredictable. High volatility, 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.23%, below average. No demo on this page.
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
